title: Keep each responsive launch start E2E journey on its own aspect

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict: Caught.** Checked revision d1f26bb70a2f197a33f1b201e1ee90b9330d9024, SEED-413#separate-launch-start-e2e-journeys.

**Promise:** while a Claude execution startup is still in progress, its story stays protected after the Take moves the card from Backlog to Taken, until the session settles: every card action disabled, source links readable, "Local startup in progress" shown.

**Fault:** `dashboard/src/StoryCard.tsx` — `const starting = offersStart && launches.storyStartupOf(sourceId, entry.identity) !== undefined;` (only Backlog cards get `offersStart`, so protection is lost only once the card is Taken; the startup text stays).

**Caught by:** `expectProtected(takenStory)` at `e2e/launches/responsive-session-start.spec.ts:145`, via `await expect(action).toBeDisabled()` at `dashboard/test-support/responsiveStart.ts:154` — the Taken card's first button ("Show Yui-chan in the agent roster") was enabled. Spec line 144 (Taken card shows "Local startup in progress") and line 141 (`expectProtected(story)` on Backlog) passed first, confirming the intended path.

**Runs** (`npx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts launches/responsive-session-start.spec.ts -g "Start execution"`, strict reporter, load ~4.5–5.7): baseline exit 0 (4066 ms); faulted exit 1 (8613 ms); restored exit 0 (3788 ms) with a clean scratch tree at d1f26bb70. Scratch worktree removed.

**Next proof action:** none for this promise.

Wrap-up disposition: d1f26bb70a2f197a33f1b201e1ee90b9330d9024, Caught, no follow-up.
